subject: FY25 School Budget Hearing
overview: The School Committee held a statutory public hearing on the superintendent's proposed FY25 operating budget, which faces a $2.7 million deficit despite $2.3 million in proposed staffing and program reductions. No formal votes were taken on the budget following extensive testimony against cuts to nurses, counselors, and arts programs.

items.title: FY25 Recommended Operating Budget Presentation
items.summary: Finance Director Gerry McCue presented the FY25 recommended operating budget, detailing $8.2 million in rising contractual and operational costs, proposed cuts resulting in a net loss of 17.4 FTE positions, and a remaining $2.7 million funding gap.

items.title: Public Hearing and Public Comment
items.summary: Dozens of students, parents, school nurses, administrative assistants, and union representatives testified against proposed reductions to nursing, guidance, drama, and administrative staff, urging city officials to use reserve funds or pursue a Proposition 2½ override.
